title: OpenMCAS: open MCAS/MCAD compound hypothesis pipeline (0.2.0)
description: OpenMCAS is an MIT-licensed, CPU-reproducible cheminformatics pipeline that ranks pharma drugs, herbs, supplements, and AI-generated analogs for mast cell activation syndrome (MCAS/MCAD) across rescue, maintenance, and remission categories. This snapshot freezes code, curated data, ranked outputs, and experiment reports at git commit 0b75955883a4.
